actor.old_price_conflict: An older cached pricing page showed USD0.55 per event. Current public API pricing history and live store both show USD0.003 from 2026-09-30; no run charged or real cost inferred.

published_free_plan.scope: Published monthly Free terms plus authenticated account plan and billing-period observation. No perpetual vendor guarantee; successful recurring AV capacity remains unproven.

pricing_scenario.origin: Reuse existing seven-source, twenty-one-window, 418-second sample plan; no full-video coverage claim.
pricing_scenario.current_assessment: CONDITIONAL_ARITHMETIC_ONLY_NOT_QUALIFIED: first real acquisition failed with zero native media; no measured successful cost, throughput, ingestion scope or retention capacity.

first_test.requested_input_coverage: Only registered [0,40] on j2rk8ycXe3c; not a full source observation.
prerequisites: Owner completes the new-account profile/terms in the secure cloud browser; browserAuth cannot create accounts.
Verify actual Free plan, fresh available balance, no card/paid billing and no competing usage before effect.
Reopen actual current Actor price and limited permissions; reject any material change or rental/full-permission requirement.
Persist one exact pending request before starting the effect; retain run ID, failure and all usage afterward.
required_proof: Actual nonempty media bytes with source ID, registered window and original source-clock mapping.
Probe actual video/audio streams, duration and decode errors; inspect native frames and decoded audio.
Review legibility and audio content; never call thumbnail, URL, ready event or provider summary a native AV pass.
Read actual run charge and fresh balance. Measure storage/transfer effects before claiming recurring sufficiency.
stop_conditions: No proxy settings, exported cookies, changed network, credential sharing or access-control bypass.
If public source fails, preserve result and stop; no unchanged retry.
No paid upgrade, payment method, recharge, trial subscription, additional Gemini or vidIQ call.
No production, channel publication, supervisor, active queue, schedule or existing quota-ledger modification.

actual_call_limits.max_items_note: No max-items control was configured in the console. One source URL only.

authentication.completion_note: Owner supplied signed-in Store screenshot; subsequent authenticated console and billing loaded. Earlier review rejections remain historical observations, not a current account-login blocker.
